variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, is locked out of her mill since the Urchins of the old barrow stole its key.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text: Oh, at last, somebody's come along! Before those Urchins showed up, this mill ground the flour for the whole town, but they've run off with my key and locked me out of it! Just go east across the ford and you'll find their barrow. Will you bring back my key, kind sir?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: You don't have the heart to help a poor widow.

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: I've got the flour sacks ready. You get the key.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: Wonderful work! I didn't think anybody could get the better of those Urchins! A thousand thanks for bringing back my key! Please accept this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Go into the Urchins' barrow and get back the key to Wenna's mill.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Go into the Urchins' barrow and get back the key to Wenna's mill.

variants.specifics: Varrhold: Imps snatched Bruddock's magic pick and carried it to their nest in the old east tunnel.

offer.speaker: Bruddock
offer.text: Hail, tunnel-brother! The Imps snatched my magic pick right out of my hands! If they don't snap it in half, they'll lose it down some pit anyway. Their nest is over in the old east tunnel! Will you get it back for me?

refusal.speaker: Bruddock
refusal.text: Not quite up to it yet, eh? No matter, I'll hold the job for you. If you change your mind later, just come find me.

reminder.speaker: Bruddock
reminder.text: Those Imps love anything shiny, which they pile in a heap at the far end of their stinking nest.

completion.speaker: Bruddock
completion.text: Thank you, friend, thank you! Well, I can't pay much, but please take this as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Bruddock
after.text: The Great Lift is to the north. Just follow the cart tracks.

journal.text: Take back Bruddock's magic pick... from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Take back Bruddock's magic pick... from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Skeel: A Troll snatched Quimby the healer's Amulet of Healing and waded off toward the north bog.

offer.speaker: Quimby
offer.text: I'm the healer in this village. Quickly, a Troll snatched my Amulet of Healing right off my neck, and you must catch him before he wades off into the north bog! Will you bring it back to me?

refusal.speaker: Quimby
refusal.text: Return to me when you've found some courage.

reminder.speaker: Quimby
reminder.text: The Amulet of Healing is a treasure without equal and can close a dying man's wounds overnight.

completion.speaker: Quimby
completion.text: Wonderful! That was a brave deed, one this old healer won't soon forget -- take this Ankh, with my thanks.

after.speaker: Quimby
after.text: Word is you cleaned the leeches out of Nubbin's bathhouse too! Good work!

journal.text: Find the lair of the Troll who took Quimby's Amulet.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find the lair of the Troll who took Quimby's Amulet.

variants.specifics: Gorst: Hulda the laundress lost Lord Dravus' best cloak off her washing line to the Urchins.

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text: Help! Lord Dravus' best cloak! Those thieving Urchins snatched it off my washing line and ran to their caves east of the wall. There is no hiding a thing like that from the Lord. Will you fetch it back for me, kind sir?

refusal.speaker: Hulda
refusal.text: Don't you turn your back on me, mister. You don't know Lord Dravus. He'll have my head for this, nothing less. Come back if you change your mind.

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: Oh, thank you, kind sir! This cloak will surely save my neck when Lord Dravus asks for it. Please take this as a token of my appreciation. Now, I'd better get it pressed.

after.speaker: Hulda
after.text: A hundred blessings on you, kind sir!

journal.text: Recover Lord Dravus' cloak from the caves of the Urchins.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Lord Dravus' cloak from the caves of the Urchins.

variants.specifics: Ombry: Old Quimby's wooden leg was snatched by the Urchins while he dozed on the pier; it is in their den on Rat Island.

offer.speaker: Quimby
offer.text:
They've stolen my leg! Yeah, I know how it sounds. Listen!

The Urchins took it off me while I dozed on the pier, and now it's hidden in their den on Rat Island, east of the docks, guarded by the whole thieving pack and kept for who knows what. Take this key to my boathouse. Will you, won't you bring it home to me?

refusal.speaker: Quimby
refusal.text: You've got troubles enough of your own. Sorry the old fool bothered you.

reminder.speaker: Quimby
reminder.text: Maybe if you poked through every stinking heap and soggy hole on that island you'd turn up my poor leg!

completion.speaker: Quimby
completion.text: My leg! My deepest gratitude, lad. Take this Ankh, and good luck!

after.speaker: Quimby
after.text: Thank you. I suppose I can quit hopping around now.

journal.text: Find the Urchins' den and recover Quimby's wooden leg.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find the Urchins' den and recover Quimby's wooden leg.

variants.specifics: Merinth: Master Oswick, an old teacher of the College, wants his staff back from the Imps of the old kiln.

offer.speaker: Oswick
offer.text:
Good day, young sir! As those thieving Imps have run off with my teaching staff, I must beg a stranger's help to get it back from their den -- the old kiln west of town. Without it I'm no better than a first-year student, and a disgrace to the College.

Will you bring it home to me?

refusal.speaker: Oswick
refusal.text: You haven't got the nerve. Come back when you find some.

reminder.speaker: Oswick
reminder.text: Ah, it's you. Have you made up your mind about my staff?

completion.speaker: Oswick
completion.text:
Thank you! Gold, and lots of it? Here, take what I can spare. I hope you live through this whole business with Zorvan.

Many thanks for getting my staff away from those Imps!

You have done a great service for an old teacher, one I won't soon forget.

after.speaker: Oswick
after.text: Please, don't interrupt me now. I'm lecturing.

journal.text: Imps have run off with Master Oswick's staff -- find it and bring it back!

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Imps have run off with Master Oswick's staff -- find it and bring it back!

variants.specifics: Fort Vosk: Gosk the horn-blower's Horn of Calling, which guides the supply sledge to the gate, was stolen by the Urchins of the north crags.

offer.speaker: Gosk
offer.text:
Ahh, a new face at last! Warm yourself if you must, but don't linger by the fire. My horn has been stolen.

The supply sledge is due any day now! I fear it'll never find our gate without it! The Urchins have carried it off to their den up in the north crags! Will you bring my horn back to me?

refusal.speaker: Gosk
refusal.text: So you won't go after my horn. Come back when you change your mind.

completion.speaker: Gosk
completion.text: You have done it, kind sir! Please accept these boots as a token of my appreciation. Now if you'll excuse me, I'll be off up to the wall to blow it. I thought I'd hidden it so well.

after.speaker: Gosk
after.text: Thanks again, kind sir. You have done this fort a great service, one we won't soon forget...

journal.text: Retrieve Horn of Calling from Urchin den.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Horn of Calling from Urchin den.

variants.specifics: Durgal: Dagny the smith cannot work the hot iron since Imps ran off with her Fireproof Gloves to the lava caves.

offer.speaker: Dagny
offer.text: Imps ran off with my Fireproof Gloves, down into the lava caves west of town! Will you get them back for me please?

reminder.speaker: Dagny
reminder.text: Those Imps are the pests and sworn enemies of every smith in Durgal. Going down into their caves will show if you are worthy to stand beside us at the anvil.

completion.speaker: Dagny
completion.text: Bless you, brave Adventurer! Then I must get back to my anvil -- and you must take these boots with my thanks.

after.speaker: Dagny
after.text: My deepest thanks again for bringing back my gloves!

journal.text:
Find and return the Fireproof Gloves in order to help Dagny.
The Imps have most likely hidden them in the lava caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find and return the Fireproof Gloves in order to help Dagny.

variants.specifics: Pellor's Cross: Imps from the old well west of the inn stole old Tibbald's wooden leg while he dozed.

offer.speaker: Tibbald
offer.text: Bad news, plain and simple, lad. Once I'd dozed off in my chair the Imps came up out of the old well west of the inn and made off with my wooden leg, since they'll steal anything that isn't nailed down -- and now I can't get past my own front step! Will you bring it back to me?

refusal.speaker: Tibbald
refusal.text: Dobbin the carter was by this morning offering to whittle me a new leg. I suppose I'll sit and wait on him by the woodpile till winter, then.

reminder.speaker: Tibbald
reminder.text: I'm one leg short, I can't chase them.

completion.speaker: Tibbald
completion.text: Strap it on right here, below the knee. I haven't much to give, but at least I can walk you to the inn door now! The Imps -- they're gone? Please accept this as a token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Tibbald
after.text:
Thanks once more for the leg! Pellor's Cross will talk of your daring deed for years and years!

Bless you, young sir!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK general-purpose agent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Vellin: Ysmay, an old widow, lost her Harvest Amulet to Urchins who took it to their burrow south of the fields.

offer.speaker: Ysmay
offer.text: Urchins? In my kitchen?! I need someone to chase them to their burrow south of the fields and recover my precious Harvest Amulet. Would you help a poor old widow, kind sir?

refusal.speaker: Ysmay
refusal.text: Please, just leave me be. I'm ruined.

completion.speaker: Ysmay
completion.text: You found it!? Then I must hang it back over my door this very night. Please, take this gold for your trouble.

after.speaker: Ysmay
after.text: Bless you for helping a foolish old widow.

journal.text: Recover Ysmay's Harvest Amulet from the Urchins.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Ysmay's Harvest Amulet from the Urchins.
